title: Spec2PR: Proving AI ROI to Leadership — The Numbers Behind 5.5 Hours Saved Per Sprint
audience: Engineering leaders, CTOs, and engineering managers making the case for AI investment
tone: Data-driven and pragmatic — evidence over enthusiasm
key_thesis: Claiming AI saves time is easy. Proving it to a CFO or VP of Engineering requires numbers, methodology, and a tracking system they can trust. This article explains how the Spec2PR productivity dashboard was built into the DevEx AI Assistant extension — tracking time saved per project, ROI calculations, and adoption metrics — and how we validated the 5.5-hour savings figure that justified continued investment and wider rollout.
